$comment: MCP servers for this repo. Claude Code loads this automatically.
explorium-docs is the Mintlify-hosted documentation MCP (search_explorium_docs,
query_docs_filesystem_explorium_docs, submit_feedback). Read-only apart from
submit_feedback.
explorium-agentsource is the separate B2B *data* API MCP (enrich-business,
match-prospects, fetch-businesses-events). It spends credits.
These are two different servers on two different hosts -- do not merge them.
BOTH authorize with OAuth: in a local Claude Code session run /mcp, pick the
server, choose Authenticate, and log in in the browser. Do not add an
Authorization header here -- it disables the OAuth flow. API keys are only
for the REST scripts and live in crm/config.py (from env), never in this file.
Remote Claude Code sessions cannot complete OAuth; for those, add the same
URL as a custom connector in claude.ai (Settings -> Connectors).
gcp-agent-registry, gcp-agent-platform and gcp-bigquery are Google Cloud's remote MCP
servers. GCP_PROJECT must be set -- scripts/gcp_mcp_env.sh does it.
Registry URN shape: urn:mcp:googleapis.com:projects:<NUMBER>:locations:global:agentregistry
and ...:aiplatform. Google's servers do NOT use the MCP OAuth flow; they take
a gcloud bearer token plus a quota-project header. The token comes from the
GCP_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN env var, which scripts/gcp_mcp_env.sh sets from
`gcloud auth application-default print-access-token` (1h lifetime). These
two entries only connect from a local session with gcloud installed.
Agent Platform is split into toolsets, one path each; /mcp/generate is the
documented one. Add more as gcp-agent-platform-<toolset> on the same pattern.
adk-docs serves the Agent Development Kit docs (adk.dev/llms.txt) over
stdio via mcpdoc, for the ADK agents under python/agents/. No credentials
and no OAuth -- it just needs uvx (ships with uv) on PATH. The 'mcp<2' pin
is load-bearing: mcpdoc imports mcp.server.fastmcp, which mcp 2.x removed.
